source: SSC CHSL examination notice (ssc.gov.in) and the paper pattern asked in past cycles
intro: Tier 1 is a screening paper of four subjects. Tier 2 goes deeper on maths, reasoning and English, and adds a computer knowledge test and a skill or typing test, depending on the post.
note: The topic lists follow the broad areas SSC publishes in its notice. SSC does not give a chapter-wise list, so use these as a checklist and treat the questions asked in the past papers as the guide to depth.

sections.name: Quantitative Aptitude
topics: Number system: whole numbers, decimals and fractions, relationship between numbers, square roots
Percentages, ratio and proportion, averages
Interest (simple and compound), profit and loss, discount, partnership
Mixture and alligation, time and distance, time and work
Basic algebra: identities and linear equations, elementary surds
Geometry: triangles and their centres, congruence and similarity, circles, chords and tangents, quadrilaterals and polygons
Mensuration: triangle, circle, cone, cylinder, sphere, hemisphere, cuboid, prism, pyramid
Trigonometry: ratios, standard identities, complementary angles, heights and distances
Statistical charts: histogram, frequency polygon, bar diagram, pie chart
sections.tip: Tier 2 mathematical abilities asks the same areas at higher difficulty, with data interpretation questions more frequent.

sections.name: General Intelligence and Reasoning
topics: Analogy and classification (semantic, number and figural)
Series: number, letter and figure
Coding and decoding, mathematical operations, number puzzles
Venn diagrams, syllogism, drawing inferences
Direction sense, blood relations, ranking and order, calendar and clock
Non-verbal: paper folding and cutting, embedded figures, pattern completion, mirror and water images, counting figures
Problem solving, arithmetical reasoning, matrix and word building

sections.name: English Language
topics: Spot the error, fill in the blanks, sentence improvement
Synonyms and antonyms, spellings, one-word substitution, idioms and phrases
Active and passive voice, direct and indirect speech, shuffling of sentence parts
Cloze test and reading comprehension
sections.tip: Tier 2 English is the biggest block of marks, so grammar accuracy and comprehension speed matter more there than in Tier 1.

sections.name: General Awareness
topics: Current events of national and international importance
India and its neighbours: history, culture, geography, economic scene, polity
Sports, awards, books and authors, important days
General science as seen in everyday life and research
Static GK: first in India, organisations, schemes, national parks and similar fact tables

sections.name: Computer Knowledge
topics: Computer basics: parts of a computer, input and output devices, memory and storage
Windows basics and file management
MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint basics and shortcuts
Internet, browsers, email and social networking
Computer networks and cyber security basics

sections.name: Skill test or typing test
topics: Typing test for LDC and JSA posts and a data entry skill test for DEO posts, with the required speed and medium (English or Hindi) fixed in the notice
sections.tip: The typing medium is chosen at the time of application, so decide it before you submit the form.
